heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny in the south; partly to mostly sunny north. Highs in the upper 50s to lower 60s. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph east of the Greens, from the south to southwest 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens, except gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Tonight
text: Variable clouds. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s, except upper 30s to mid 40s in the broad valleys west. South to southwest winds decreasing to 5 mph or less, except 5 to 10 mph and gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny, except partly cloudy from Route 2 northward. Highs from the mid 50s to lower 60s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west in the afternoon.
